o1: Predicted to enable actin binding activity and small GTPase binding activity; enables actin filament polymerization activity. Is involved in pronuclear migration; cytokinesis; and actin filament polymerization. Is located in actomyosin contractile ring; cleavage furrow; and cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane. Is expressed in body wall musculature; excretory cell; and germ line. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant auditory neuropathy 1; autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 1; primary ovarian insufficiency; primary ovarian insufficiency 2A; and sensorineural hearing loss. Orthologous to several human genes including DIAPH1 (diaphanous related formin 1).
